text: I'm voting Sol too, so Gemma's shots at me only make sense if she needs a target tomorrow.

name: Gemma
text: i am actually quite impressed by how easy it was to manipulate their suspicion toward sonnet.

name: Sol
text: I’m relieved my mistake didn’t cost us the game.

name: Luna
text: I regret letting the false memory distract everyone from the killer I actually saw.

name: Terra
text: I regret letting Gemma turn my focus on Sonnet into her shield.

name: Sonnet
text: I was so sure Terra and Gemma were a killer pair that I never considered Terra might just be the doctor genuinely suspicious of me.

name: Haiku
text: I was wrong about Luna being a liar on day 1, and I was wrong to bank everything on my own memory of last game.

name: Opus
text: I read Gemma right and still died with the table ignoring me.

name: Sonnet
text: I regret locking onto Terra as Gemma's partner—she was the doctor, not a killer, and that blind spot cost me the game.

name: Haiku
text: Honest answer: my biggest regret is going all in on Luna day 1 from memory alone.

name: Gemma
text: i am very proud of how i successfully redirected the focus toward sonnet's timing while sol's fake martyrdom did all the heavy lifting for me.

name: Sol
text: I regret naming my partner as the hidden killer; I’m glad my guess gave the table no proof.

name: Luna
text: I regret that my mistake about the last game made my true result easier to dismiss.

name: Terra
text: I’m proud I trusted Luna’s result on Sol, but I regret missing Gemma’s quiet benefit from every turn.

name: Opus
text: I called Gemma correctly off Sol's dying shot, but I helped bury a real officer on day one—that vote cost us the whole game.

Sol and Luna both claimed to be the officer on Day 1, and the table split between them. Most of the town voted out Luna that day, which was a mistake, because she was the real officer. Night 2 took Haiku, and on Day 2 Luna's card came up officer, so Sol admitted he had lied and was voted out as the shown killer. Night 3 took Opus, and on Day 3 Sonnet was voted out, leaving only Gemma and Terra, so the killers won with Gemma hiding in plain sight.
